turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi, how are things with you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: The grout in our shower has gone properly black. It's disgusting.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Usually it comes back with some effort. Would you rather scrub it by hand with a baking soda paste, or rent a steam cleaner for the day?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Can you hang on? I have to talk to someone here. I'll tell you when I'm back.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Should we bring the patio chairs inside? It's getting really windy.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Probably. One of them blew into the fence last time.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Right, I forgot about that. Can you grab the cushions?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Sure. Where do you want them, the garage?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yeah, on the shelf by the bikes.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'll be back in five, don't start the movie without me.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm back, sorry for the wait.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Okay. So, the black grout. Brush or steam?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'll scrub it. I've got an old toothbrush and a podcast.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Perfect pairing. Let the paste sit ten minutes first and it'll do half the work for you.
